messages.subject: Facetting and geom_hline
parts:
Hi Hadley,

I am wondering if the problem of facetting with geom_hline is still a bug (as I saw it in a message in some of your forums) or I am doing something wrong.
When I use geom_hline with facet_grid to add the same horizontal line to all plots it adds additional empty plot named 1 and 2 (my facetting is 1 rowX2columns).

Thanks for your help and for the great job your are doing.

Af

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Facetting and geom_hline

Hi Afif,

It's always hard for me to tell without a reproducible example. The
best way is to point to the bug report (on
http://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues) and provide a small
reproducible example. That way I can either confirm it's the same, or
realise that it's a new bug I don't know about.

Hadley
